# hbctl

> Fast, single-binary, agent-friendly Rust CLI client for interacting with remote Homebox v0.26+ instances over the REST API.

`hbctl` centralizes Homebox inventory management for both interactive terminal workflows and AI-agent automation. It separates `stdout` data (`table`, compact `json` with `--select`, `plain`, `csv`, `markdown`, or `-q` IDs) from `stderr` diagnostics, protects mutations with `GET -> Merge -> PUT` semantics and `--dry-run` previews (`Bearer ***` redaction), and resolves settings across CLI flags, environment variables, `.hbctl.toml`, and `~/.config/hbctl/config.toml` profiles with OS keyring + `0600` file fallback storage.

## Documentation

- [README](docs/README.md): Project overview, installation quickstart, usage examples, and configuration precedence.
- [Docs Home](docs/index.md): Static Zensical documentation homepage.

- [Usage](docs/usage.md): Complete CLI reference covering global flags, items, attachments, search, fields, tags, entity types, maintenance, stats, templates, barcodes, labels, QR codes, actions, notifiers, config, raw API, exports, and backups.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): Layered precedence, multi-instance `[profiles.<name>]`, image auto-optimization settings, and environment variables.
- [Authentication & Security](docs/security.md): OS keyring + `0600` file fallback, token lifecycle, `Bearer ***` masking, notifier URL redaction, and backup sanitization.
- [Config Example](assets/config.example.toml): Annotated TOML configuration template for single and multi-profile setups.
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): Repository architecture, module map, coding conventions, and quality gates.

## Core Source Modules

- [CLI Parser](src/cli.rs): `clap` derive parser, global options, subcommands, shell completions, and man page generator.
- [Configuration](src/config.rs): Layered config loader, URL/`HOMEBOX_IP` normalization, profile resolution, and secret redaction.
- [Credential Store](src/auth_store.rs): Cross-platform OS keyring storage with `0600` file fallback (`credentials.json`) scoped per profile.
- [HTTP Client](src/client/mod.rs): Homebox v0.26+ REST client with retry/backoff, `GET -> Merge -> PUT`, follow-up `PUT` for custom fields, concurrent hydration, and streaming attachment downloads.
- [API Models](src/client/models.rs): Serde models with Go-`null` tolerance, typed custom fields, warranty/insurance/sold/archived fields, templates, barcodes, notifiers, stats, and maintenance.
- [Entity & Tag Resolver](src/client/resolve.rs): Name/UUID resolution and auto-creation helpers for tags and entity types.
- [Command Dispatcher](src/commands/mod.rs): Top-level command routing and shared item ID / rendering helpers across 20 command modules.
- [Backup Command](src/commands/backup.rs): Portable full-inventory directory and `.tar.gz` archive backup generator with `manifest.json` and attachment disambiguation.
- [Deduplication Engine](src/dedup.rs): Two-pass exact and Jaccard token similarity duplicate detector and deterministic keeper selector.
- [Image Optimizer](src/image_opt.rs): In-memory EXIF-aware image resizing and JPEG/PNG/WebP compression pipeline.
- [Output Renderers](src/output.rs): `table`, compact `json` (`--select`), `plain`, `csv`, `markdown`, `--dry-run`, and `--quiet` formatters.
- [Self-Updater](src/update.rs): GitHub release checker and in-place binary updater (`hbctl update` / `hbctl self-update`).
- [Domain Errors](src/error.rs): Typed `HbctlError` variants via `thiserror`.
